event_records.description: Rustam's escalated warranty claim is in the queue of the manufacturer's second-line team, awaiting a decision.

rustam.name: Rustam
rustam.persona_brief:
You are Rustam.
Rustam has an escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine. He received an email yesterday (2026-08-04) stating that the manufacturer's second-line team would make a decision within ten working days. He wants a decision within that timeframe.

manufacturer_s_second_line_team.name: Manufacturer's second-line team
manufacturer_s_second_line_team.persona_brief:
You are Manufacturer's second-line team.
The second-line team handles escalated warranty claims. They have a queue of claims and must decide on each. They are aware of the ten-working-day commitment but may have varying workloads and priorities.

resolution.question: Will Rustam's escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine get a decision from the manufacturer's second-line team within the ten working days quoted in yesterday's email?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the manufacturer's second-line team communicated a decision (approval or denial) to Rustam before 2026-08-19T18:00:00+05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
